text: You know that Friday feeling, when you're already planning Saturday's ride?
Pick a trail, and it tells you straight whether you can ride it.
Even the warnings, like slippery after rain, come from riders who've been there.
Then pick a place, and your route draws itself along real roads.
Check the distance, and you're ready to go.
Riding with friends? Start a group ride, and share the code.
Everyone shows up on the map, so you'll always know if someone's falling behind.
And if you ever need help...
Just hold SOS. You can call for help, or share exactly where you are.
Every ride gets saved, so you can look back on your whole year.
